metadata.coverage: Boat launches, docks and piers, and shore access sites in the provincial Fishing Access Point inventory, limited to the ones the province marks for public display.
metadata.completeness_note: Not every launch or shore access is in the province's inventory, and sites the province asks not to be mapped are left out. No point on the map is not evidence there is no access.
metadata.unknown_note: Parking, fees, surface and accessibility are shown only where the province recorded them. Most sites leave them unrecorded.
metadata.note: Where the water starts, not whether you may fish it: seasons, sanctuaries and limits come from the Ontario Fishing Regulations Summary. A privately owned site may charge or refuse use.
metadata.source: Ontario Fishing Access Point (Land Information Ontario)
